### `ArchIrqRegister` { #archirqregister }

```c
bool ArchIrqRegister(uint32_t irq_id, IrqHandler handler, void *ctx);
```

[Register](../../arm/include/arch_impl/regs.md#register) a handler for an interrupt.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `irq_id` | in | Interrupt number. |
